prompts.name: musk_ai1
prompts.prompt: Use the man in the reference photo (keep his face, hairstyle and likeness recognizable). Vertical 4:5 editorial magazine cover image, photorealistic cinematic style. Keep the bottom third of the image fairly dark and simple (space for a headline). No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. Scene: he stands smiling in a dark suit on a launch site at golden hour, holding out a small gift box tied with a ribbon toward the camera; behind him a tall silver Starship-style rocket on the pad and a crowd of happy American children of diverse backgrounds holding small gift boxes, warm sunset light.
